stories.text: 🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: Mr. Action Jackson just moved above the projected league median.
🔥 Brock You Like a Hurricane dropped 188.98 points — the week's highest score.
🔮 Ramosverse vs Mr. Action Jackson is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 21.35 pts.
⚔️ Ruffing the Passer edged TDsMaGee by just 1.98 points.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Moose Knucklers leads the chopping-block odds at 16.30%, with Mel's Magnificent Team next at 15.14%.
🤦 TDsMaGee would have won and finished above the median by starting Wan'Dale Robinson (18.70) over Jadarian Price (1.20).
🤝 Rivalry week: Kirbo Crushers leads Claremont In Yo Stace! 7–3 all-time.
🪦 Plan B got the axe in On Mondays Heads Will Roll with 116.43 pts, 3.28 pts short of Stacey's Smart Team.

🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race: TDsMaGee, The Mahomies, Ruffing the Passer, Gibb it to Me Baby, Kyle Tucker, Claremont In Yo Stace!, 49er Faith-Fool, Mr. Action Jackson, Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy and Ramosverse.
😬 Kyle Tucker scored 133.96 and still took the L.
🤝 Rivalry week: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy leads Kyle Tucker 5–3 all-time, and Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy has won the last 3.
💥 Brock You Like a Hurricane beat Kyle Tucker 188.98-133.96 (55.02 points).

🏈 Matchups that matter: Gibb it to Me Baby vs TDsMaGee (Gibb it to Me Baby 52.98%) · Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Kyle Tucker (Kyle Tucker 53.08%) · 49er Faith-Fool vs The Mahomies (49er Faith-Fool 56.23%) · Ruffing the Passer vs Brock You Like a Hurricane (Brock You Like a Hurricane 68.08%) · Ramosverse vs Mr. Action Jackson (Mr. Action Jackson 69.88%) · Kirbo Crushers vs Claremont In Yo Stace! (Claremont In Yo Stace! 72.27%).
🪑 Gibb it to Me Baby left 31.28 points on the bench with Brock Purdy.
🔥 Brock You Like a Hurricane has won 3 straight. Ruffing the Passer gets the next crack at them.
🥶 Kirbo Crushers has dropped 3 straight. Can they snap it against Claremont In Yo Stace!?
🏆 Title odds entering Week 4: Brock You Like a Hurricane 25.04%, Gibb it to Me Baby 15.75%, 49er Faith-Fool 13.28%.
⚔️ Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Kyle Tucker is projected to finish just 2.96 pts apart.

🗞️ Fresh off the wire: The Mahomies added Bears D/ST (D/ST, projected 6.27 pts), Ramosverse added Mack Hollins (WR, projected 9.76 pts) and Mr. Action Jackson added Malik Washington (WR, projected 10.07 pts).
📈 Stock rising: Brock You Like a Hurricane has its ESPN projection trending up.
📉 Stock falling: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy's ESPN projection is trending down.
